files.content:
schema_version = "1.4"

artifacts = [
    "/var/tmp/mimo-separate",
    "/logs/agent/trajectory.json",
]

[task]
name = "mimo-v2.6-rl/format-code-task-001425"
description = "I want Stripe-backed customer objects to manage subscription lifecycles directly from the customer instance."
keywords = ["mimo-v2.6-rl", "code"]

[metadata]
adapter = "mimo_harbor 1.1.0"
category = "Python"
domain = "code"
keywords = ["code", "Python"]
reference_harness = "XiaomiMiMo/verl a2ad9f6 + XiaomiMiMo/mimoagent 467f0a1"
reference_step_limit = 500
source_dataset = "XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-RL-oss"
source_id = "format-code-task-001425"
source_revision = "639865fd3374018d6cb29b9fb82dd531406fcf5f"
title = "I want Stripe-backed customer objects to manage subscription lifecycles directly from the customer instance."

[agent]
network_mode = "no-network"
timeout_sec = 3600.0

[verifier]
environment_mode = "separate"
timeout_sec = 2100.0
user = "root"

[environment]
docker_image = "docker.io/xiaomimimo/mimo-v2.6-rl-oss@sha256:b4c25824f73c9f525f03033a41499dd8971e2fcd66d60aef6c0a5ac37f7d1147"
workdir = "/workspace/repo"
cpus = 2
memory_mb = 8192
network_mode = "public"
build_timeout_sec = 1800.0

[environment.healthcheck]
# one-time setup before the agent (environment/setup/setup.sh)
command = "bash -c 'test -f /var/lib/mimo/ready || { mkdir -p /var/lib/mimo && echo  | base64 -d | tar -xzf - -C /var/lib/mimo && bash /var/lib/mimo/setup.sh; }'"
timeout_sec = 1200.0
retries = 0
interval_sec = 5.0

# separate-verifier@1: snapshot the agent workspace for the verifier.
# The probe hook runs first so the snapshot tarballs are not scanned.
[[verifier.collect]]
service = "main"
command = 'SNAP="/var/tmp/mimo-separate"; CWD="/workspace/repo"; mkdir -p "$SNAP"; { echo "== ls /tests =="; ls -la /tests 2>&1; echo "== grep marker test_create_subscription_with_price_id_creates_and_pays_invoice =="; grep -rl "test_create_subscription_with_price_id_creates_and_pays_invoice" "$CWD" /tmp --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.venv --exclude-dir=venv --exclude-dir=node_modules 2>/dev/null; echo "grep_rc=$?"; } > "$SNAP/probe-agent-env.txt" 2>&1; cat "$SNAP/probe-agent-env.txt"; true'
timeout_sec = 300.0
user = "root"

[[verifier.collect]]
service = "main"
command = 'SNAP="/var/tmp/mimo-separate"; CWD="/workspace/repo"; mkdir -p "$SNAP"; LIST="$SNAP/files"; git -C "$CWD" ls-files -c -o --exclude-standard -z > "$LIST" 2>/dev/null; if [ -s "$LIST" ]; then tar --null --exclude=.git -czf "$SNAP/workspace.tgz" -C "$CWD" --files-from="$LIST"; else tar --exclude=.git -czf "$SNAP/workspace.tgz" -C "$CWD" .; fi; ls -la "$SNAP"; true'
timeout_sec = 600.0
user = "root"

rationale: Declare [agent] network_mode = "no-network" so the agent phase cannot fetch the upstream fix / newer release (V6) on any Harbor backend, while the separate verifier keeps the public baseline that network-dependent graders need.
